courseTitle: Ionic - Build iOS, Android & Web Apps with Ionic & Angular

cues.en: This is it for this module,
we covered a lot of different aspects of using forms and handling user input in Ionic apps.
You learned that both the template-driven approach, like here in the auth page, as well as the reactive
approach, as in the new offer page work and that you can use all the form features and validation directives
and techniques you already know from Angular.
You also learned about the special or some special new inputs Ionic gives you, like for example that nice
you saw a bit how you can configure it and how you may validate it which can be very useful and unnecessary
but as always, the docs are your friend for deep dives into all these components and also into other form
control related components, like checkboxes or toggles which we didn't cover here.
With that, we got a nice app and we're finally able to gather some data from our users. Therefore in the
next module, we'll now have a look at using that data to make sure we can actually create new places,
edit them and so on before we then later also add functionality to enrich this with a custom picture,
with getting a location or picking a location on a map
and of course, with sending all that data to a server.
